The roadhouse offers trailhead parking with direct access to ATV/UTV trail 33A. A few sites have waste holding tanks; nightly, weekly, monthly and seasonal rates. --Claude
summary: Operator site (home, about, get-local, rest-camp), Firefly form and Google read; imagery shows a separate campground loop. Booking now operator/Firefly with URL; 18 sites, 30/50-amp electric and water confirmed. Price and availability unread (Firefly search answered Recaptcha). Not a bar lot. OHV flag (trailhead parking, direct ATV/UTV trail access).
flags: NOT A BAR LOT: Esri imagery shows a gravel campground loop with about 15-18 angled back-in spurs and a service building SW of the roadhouse, centroid about 45.3778,-91.6451, separate from the bar's gravel lot (pin at the roadhouse, ~90 m away: fine). The operator sells RV sites by the night on Firefly ('Reservation Duration Type: Nightly'; a Class C motorhome is an offered equipment type). Inclusion evidence ok.

OHV (reviewer decides): get-local says 'We offer trailhead parking and direct access to Trail #33A via ATV/UTV Trails'. It reads as a roadhouse campground on the trail network rather than an OHV staging camp: the camp is sold as a general 'rest camp' (lakes, farmland, Chetek Chain of Lakes), and OHV is one of several draws. The stored note already mentions the trails.

PRICE/LONG-STAY UNREAD: Firefly's availability search returned 'ErrorCode: Recaptcha' (not retried), so no nightly rate or nightly share was read. The operator lists 'Nightly - Weekly - Monthly - Seasonal Rates' and Firefly offers an 'Ongoing - Pay monthly' type, so some sites may be long-stay; the nightly share could not be measured. Price evidence stays the RV Life $$ tier (price_tier 2).
GOOGLE: 4.5 (531) is the roadhouse's rating (restaurant and bar under the same listing), not the campground's alone.
UNSOURCED: no sewer value written; 'Waste holding tanks available at select sites' is not a sewer hookup. Season not stated for the camp (the restaurant is year-round).
